requests.title: Shenzhen, Wednesday 18 Nov: the US President arrives for the APEC summit; the pool camera on the arrival ceremony, unedited.

candidates.ref: File:President Trump Participates in a Shenzhen, China Arrival Ceremony.webm

fit.why: The White House's own unedited pool record of the arrival ceremony at Shenzhen on Wednesday 18 Nov (421.8 s, one camera, no graphic seen in fifteen sampled frames): from about 45 s the President is at Air Force One's door, waves, and descends the red steps toward the welcome line by 70 s. Its own nat sound plays. The US is a party to the summit, so the shot carries RELEASED BY THE WHITE HOUSE once the party label exists (T5).

requests.title: The Kerch bridge, 17 Nov: the Security Service of Ukraine's own video of its strike (thermal approach, the impact, the arch down in daylight).

fit.why: The Security Service of Ukraine's own video of its strike on the Kerch bridge, released 17 Nov: a thermal drone approach to the arch (0.17 to 22.99 s), the impact at night (22.99 to 26.99 s), the arch down in daylight (26.99 s on). The span starts after the 0.17 s title card ('fourth SSU strike') and stops at 28.8 s, before the SSU's end card wipes in (between 28.8 and 29.4 s). Party label RELEASED BY THE SECURITY SERVICE OF UKRAINE; the SSU's own bug sits top left.

requests.title: Shenzhen, Thursday 19 Nov: Putin's news conference, his answer on the attacks on the Crimean Bridge (the Kremlin's own record).

fallback.text: tier 4: the locator, Kerch Strait; the narrator attributes

fit.why: The Kremlin's own record of Putin's news conference in Shenzhen on 19 Nov (a news conference by the page's own title). The page's contents put 'The attacks on the Crimean Bridge' at 22:45 to 25:40; sampled frames show the question from the floor at about 22:46 and Putin answering at the lectern from about 23:00 to 25:35. The span is that answer; the bite is cut inside it at sentence bounds at the transcript step. Party label RELEASED BY THE KREMLIN.

requests.title: The Kremlin's English transcript of the 19 Nov news conference: Putin's words on the Crimean Bridge and negotiations, the page the reader speaks.

fit.why: The Kremlin's English transcript of the 19 Nov news conference: Putin says the Crimean Bridge is a civilian facility and that 'following the strikes on the Crimean Bridge, there will be no negotiations'. The reader speaks it as TRANSLATION · KREMLIN TRANSCRIPT.

requests.title: Shenzhen, Wednesday 18 Nov: Putin's address to the APEC CEO Summit (the Kremlin's own record).

fit.why: The Kremlin's own record of Putin's address to the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen on 18 Nov (1177.7 s, multi-camera, no bug seen in nine sampled frames). The Russian page carries the video (the English page lists none). From 110 to 130 s: Putin at the lectern and the wide hall under the summit's banner; the bite is chosen at the transcript step and replaces this span. Its kind is not read from its title ('Деловой саммит форума АТЭС'), so the ledger airs it muted until a checking role reviews record_kind. Party label RELEASED BY THE KREMLIN.
